2e002915-ec51-5bf5-9e04-c00b4f71884e.content: The user keeps the shared laundry-room access card in an entrance drawer.

932a3797-6c7d-5d59-9fdb-2570807107ae.content: The user went downstairs 25 minutes after the laundry finished and received a note from another household.

18ede3bf-03df-5632-b167-b49e630384a8.content: For the next load, the user set a reminder five minutes before the end and removed the laundry immediately.

0937bbbb-a672-51b8-bdcf-09ab792655bc.content: The user washed light-colored clothes with new jeans, and color transferred onto white socks.

7b2f023c-58ad-5298-934b-b3793bc092a2.content: The user later washed the new jeans separately, and the color of the other clothes did not change.

4f04d741-16bf-5abe-8ef4-1136c2824f8f.content: On a day the user did not check the dryer filter, the clothes needed another drying cycle.

e202f177-36e8-5372-929d-d0ebb11599b7.content: On the next use, after emptying the filter, the user finished drying in one cycle.

cd35cf13-9365-5584-ab16-e72515e850fe.content: The building manager judges that not leaving finished laundry for a long time is fair to other households.

904b8ce3-195d-5390-9ef9-dbb39bc19a65.content: When creating a shared laundry-room reminder, base it on the end time of the machine the user started.

8ad08c0b-ec8d-53ff-9fb9-099ac80bc006.content: Even if the local agent knows where the card is kept, it cannot know which machines in the shared laundry room are currently available.
